arcSummary: Harl guarded a sealed sanctum for thirty years without knowing what it held. Then someone finally opened a door he'd given his life to, and he came to see whose hands did it.

stages.title: Thirty Years of Not Knowing
stages.summary: The emptied sanctum is on the route. He requests a detour, in the tone of a man requesting a funeral.

stages.title: Seeing It
stages.summary: He has never asked what the seal held. He is asking now, and he wants to hear it standing up.

stages.title: A Door Worth a Warden
stages.summary: The campus keeps things now: records, relics, one held moment. He has inspected every door in the place.
